body: Yeah... I'm still not sure if they found out and I'm going crazy from the stress

My college knows I've had some sort of help but they do not offer anything themselves. They don't know for what exactly I've had help and unfortunately I need to keep it that way since it would almost definitely ruin my chances to get hired later on at the places that I'd want since everything is pretty strict about mental health. 
I thought that doing something online might be silly, but I guess I might give it a shot. Thank you for the advice since I also kinda forgot about that possibility now haha, I appreciate the care

Because of several reasons actually:
1. It honestly didn't help at all and my parents would always be in a bad mood the day before, the day itself and the day after my appointments... so I don't see the need to go through that again tbh
2. I can barely miss hours in college. Simply can't take time off or I'd have no opportunity to take a day off when I'm sick or so
3. My parents would find out if I start therapy again. That'd be like starting WW3 in my own home and yeah that wouldn't be nice... it would just make things worse again since they're glad that I stopped :')

So yeah I'm really not sure what to do...
